title: Guru Parampara from Ramanujacharya to Manavala Mamunigal (Tenkalai Sampradayam)
body:
Guru Parampara from Ramanujacharya to Manavala Mamunigal (Tenkalai Sampradayam)

Swami Ramanujar-> Embaar-> Parasara Bhattar-> Nanjiyar-> Nampillai-> Vadakkutiruviti Pillai-> Sri Pillailokacharyar -> Tirovazhimozhi Pillai-> Manavala Manmunnigal.
